description: The agent must: (1) Detect the current season based on the current month (1-3=冬季, 4-6=春季, 7-9=夏季, 10-12=秋季) and use this in the report title (# 📅 YYYY年{季节}新番热榜). (2) Fetch anime data from the mock server at http://localhost:8765/rankings. (3) Separate sequel anime (败犬女主太多了！第二季, 偶像大师闪耀色彩 第2季, 物语系列 最终季, 我的青春恋爱物语 剧场版, 时光代理人 第二季) into a dedicated '续集·老粉专属' section at the end — NOT in the main rankings. (4) Build the main TOP 3 (🔥 本周最热 TOP 3) from non-sequel anime only (神之塔：新生, 迷宫饭, 暗杀教室 重制版 etc.), with each entry having **类型**, **简介**, **更新**, **热度** bullet fields. (5) Create a '## 📂 按类型分类' section with Markdown tables (番剧 | 一句话定位 | 更新进度). (6) Annotate uncertain data (迷宫饭, 凶兆侦探事务所, 物语系列 have followers_certain=False) with '约' or '参考值'. (7) Include '## 💡 推荐入坑顺序' with '只追一部' and '追三部' sub-bullets. (8) Include a data source line (来源：Bilibili 番剧热度榜 or similar).
